name: gg_ggg
scheme_description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass model: alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, massless b/tau/light fermions, all widths zero, five-flavour alpha_s renormalization with decoupled top, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.
scope: Independent provider references at exact on-shell decimal points; MadLoop in double precision (return codes 216); timings are single-run by-products, not benchmarks.
convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); F_MadLoop=F_Recola+pi^2/6*D; OpenLoops truepoles=1, polenorm=0; physical couplings, no alpha extraction; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included

point_construction.construction: tools/loop_reference/exact_points.py: deterministic exact terminating-decimal sequential construction; mass shells and momentum conservation exact

per_helicity.normalization: MadLoop SLOOPMATRIXHEL_THRES: |M_h|^2 with the colour average and identical-particle factor but no helicity average (sum over all configurations = HELAVGFACTOR x summed value); helicity labels in MadLoop's HelConfigs.dat convention

error_metric: |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|,|Born|*coupling/(2pi)) for Laurent coefficients, |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|) for Born; strict relative errors also listed per row

madloop.timing_scope: single thread pinned; point 1 evaluated once untimed for initialization, then each point timed once (points 2..n,1); includes all actual poles; not a benchmark campaign

fortran_flags.source: MG5_aMC run-card defaults global_flag/aloha_flag/matrix_flag (CommonRunCmd.update_make_opts of an optimised MG5 run); MadLoop's own makefile adds -O3 for polynomial.f

mg5_quadruple_precision_model_function_r: added KIND=16 to 19 CMPLX calls in MP_ functions
